data.body: **[P2] Validate the actual interface method descriptor.** `Class#getMethod` can select a stale provider's unrelated concrete covariant-return overload or static helper, so checking only `isAbstract()` accepts a class that still lacks the instance `DurableExecutionPlugin createPlugin(InvocationInfo)` descriptor or compiler bridge. Invocation then fails with `AbstractMethodError`/`IncompatibleClassChangeError`, is contained, and leaves the requested instrumentation disabled instead of failing startup. Require a non-static, non-abstract public method with the exact erased return descriptor, and add stale-class fixtures for these collisions.
